name: darkest_den
comment: Den of Evil arena: our own copy of the Pit level 2 room (Blizzard's act1/caves/caveroom5, 24x24 tiles), a round cave. Kept as its own map so it can be reused later (post-Act V content). The waypoint stands in the north-west, where the Pit's stairs come in (those stairs lead nowhere here); the fight comes from the south-east. Its treasure chests are left out (drop_objects).

extra_objects.comment: WaypointOutsideAct1 (objpreset Act 1 Index 52). Its HD look is the prefab below, placed as in the game's act1/outdoors/waypoint map (object at sub-tile 14,14 -> prefab at 37,38).
